@graph.name: ChordPro Songs & Setlists Profile
@graph.description: A minimal RO-Crate profile for songbooks harvested from ChordPro song charts and Markdown setlists (resources2crate's chordpro-input plugin).

@graph.rdfs:label: Thing
@graph.name: Thing
@graph.rdfs:comment: The most generic type of item.

@graph.rdfs:label: CreativeWork
@graph.name: CreativeWork
@graph.rdfs:comment: The most generic kind of creative work, including books, movies, photographs, software programs, etc.

@graph.rdfs:label: Dataset
@graph.name: Dataset
@graph.rdfs:comment: A body of structured information describing some topic(s) of interest.

@graph.rdfs:label: MusicComposition
@graph.name: MusicComposition
@graph.rdfs:comment: A musical composition.

@graph.rdfs:label: MusicPlaylist
@graph.name: MusicPlaylist
@graph.rdfs:comment: A collection of music tracks in playlist form.

@graph.rdfs:label: Text
@graph.name: Text
@graph.rdfs:comment: Data type: Text.

@graph.rdfs:label: URL
@graph.name: URL
@graph.rdfs:comment: Data type: URL.

@graph.rdfs:label: Date
@graph.name: Date
@graph.rdfs:comment: A date value in [ISO 8601 date format](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601).

@graph.rdfs:label: description
@graph.name: description
@graph.rdfs:comment: A description of the item.

@graph.rdfs:label: datePublished
@graph.name: datePublished
@graph.rdfs:comment: Date of first publication or broadcast. For example the date a [[CreativeWork]] was broadcast or a [[Certification]] was issued.

@graph.rdfs:label: license
@graph.name: license
@graph.rdfs:comment: A license document that applies to this content, typically indicated by URL.

@graph.rdfs:label: hasPart
@graph.name: hasPart
@graph.rdfs:comment: Indicates an item or CreativeWork that is part of this item, or CreativeWork (in some sense).

@graph.rdfs:label: musicalKey
@graph.name: musicalKey
@graph.rdfs:comment: The key, mode, or scale this composition uses.

@graph.rdfs:label: composer
@graph.name: composer
@graph.rdfs:comment: The person or organization who wrote a composition, or who is the composer of a work performed at some event.

@graph.rdfs:label: performer
@graph.name: performer
@graph.rdfs:comment: A performer at the event—for example, a presenter, musician, musical group or actor.

@graph.rdfs:label: MusicCompositionSong
@graph.name: MusicCompositionSong
@graph.rdfs:comment: A canonical song, harvested from one ChordPro chart file — chordpro-input's own specialization of MusicComposition, never carrying specializationOf.

@graph.rdfs:label: MusicCompositionSongProxy
@graph.name: MusicCompositionSongProxy
@graph.rdfs:comment: One setlist entry — a lightweight performance-slot proxy, not a second copy of the song — chordpro-input's own specialization of MusicComposition, linked to the song it performs via specializationOf.

@graph.rdfs:label: name
@graph.name: name
@graph.rdfs:comment: The songbook's own title.

@graph.rdfs:label: name
@graph.name: name
@graph.rdfs:comment: A top-level setlist's own title (e.g. "Friday Gig"), or — on a nested "#" set — that set's own heading text (e.g. "Set 1"); MusicPlaylist covers both (SPEC.md §6).

@graph.rdfs:label: name
@graph.name: name
@graph.rdfs:comment: A canonical song's own title.

@graph.rdfs:label: name
@graph.name: name
@graph.rdfs:comment: The raw heading text for this setlist entry, taken verbatim from the setlist file — may be a fuzzy or approximate match to the song it specializes, not necessarily identical to that song's own name.

@graph.rdfs:label: text
@graph.name: text
@graph.rdfs:comment: The song's own verbatim ChordPro source (directives and all) — the one place its full text lives; every setlist entry that performs it points back here rather than carrying its own copy.

@graph.rdfs:label: text
@graph.name: text
@graph.rdfs:comment: This entry's own short performance note, written as Markdown and rendered as such — optional; absent on most entries. Never the song's own text, which lives on the MusicCompositionSong it specializes instead.

@graph.rdfs:label: text
@graph.name: text
@graph.rdfs:comment: A setlist's or a "#" set's own freeform note, written as Markdown and rendered as such — optional; the freeform text found between a "#" heading and its first entry, or authored anywhere for a top-level setlist.

@graph.rdfs:label: subtitle
@graph.name: subtitle
@graph.rdfs:comment: A secondary title for the item — chordpro-input's own use: a song's {subtitle}/{st} ChordPro directive.

@graph.rdfs:label: specializationOf
@graph.name: specializationOf
@graph.rdfs:comment: chordpro-input's own use: links a setlist-entry MusicCompositionSongProxy to the canonical MusicCompositionSong it performs.
